mechanism.claim: In a causally high-variation funding cycle, an unusually large one-settlement funding-rate change is a leverage-demand shock that mean-reverts over the next settlement cycle.
mechanism.why_distinct: Unlike HVFADR, this policy does not require or follow price/funding divergence, has no onset rule, and interprets the funding first difference itself as a crowded shock to fade.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: the completed intervening eight-hour BTC realized variation must be in its causal upper 40 percent
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: actual funding-settlement first-difference shocks are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.previous_settlement: immediately prior actual settlement P with S-P exactly 8 elapsed hours
features.change_rank: strict-prior midrank of absolute funding_change over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.70
features.realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared one-minute log(close/open) returns over exactly 480 coherent BTCUSDT bars [P,S))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 source-valid cycles; current excluded; minimum 180; rank>=0.60
features.eligible: both ranks pass at S; no divergence, onset, funding-level, OI, premium, alt, or post-settlement condition

clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal entry
clock.funding: signal settlement precedes entry; exact held settlements only after source and Gross9 pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

source_plan.bars: Postgres bars_binance BTCUSDT exact coherent 1m OHLC
source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 pass

research_boundary.classification: exploratory discovery; not fresh confirmatory evidence

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no settlement gap, history, rank, side, variation, clock, hold, subset, threshold, comparator, or control repair
